description: Selected second-pass attribution measurements. Times are milliseconds; CPU profile categories are sampled self time, not wall-clock phase durations. Full traces remain local under benchmarks/.work/.

baselineImport.method: Five fresh, unprofiled Node processes. Baseline samples retained in run order from an interleaved five-variant compiler comparison.

profiles.method: 100 unique-source dashboard transforms in production mode, after the fixture and distinct-module passes. Inspector sampling interval 100 microseconds. Both variants configured with build.sourcemap=false; #305 still constructed maps.

parserProbe.method: Five sequential batches of 20 passes over all 18 fixture JS/TS modules except generated Css.ts. Each sample is batch milliseconds divided by 20. Babel uses typescript/jsx plugins; Oxc parseSync uses lang=tsx. Both read program.body, including AST transfer. These are parser-only observations from discarded experiments, not end-to-end comparisons.
